method: judging.md section 10: claims from the arm's own notes checked against render/*.png (canonical renders) and facts.json; no scoring, no comparison with other arms
sources: out/NOTES.md (no out/rationale.md; no other notes in out/)
feedback/*.md (3 skill-feedback notes about process, read for context; their one visual claim, 13px table text, cannot be measured from renders or facts)

notes: Also verified but not listed: pagination 共 1,286 条, pages up to 86 (render/list-02.png); 派单 comes first in row actions for 0402, before 查看; keyword placeholder reads 工单号、标题、设备; masked phone 138****2716; breadcrumb 工单管理 / 工单列表 / GD-20260927-0413 with 工单列表 still active in the sidebar; photo placeholders with captions; repair SLA bar at about 12.5%; the header select-all checkbox is drawn greyed out on the empty and error screens.
